title: The write step's site check lets the brief's WhatsApp and the business's own social profiles pass cta-real, and nothing else off the demo
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: Every page read of the site check sends whatsappLinks and socialLinks from the brief; no brief sends none.
With them the brief's WhatsApp and profile buttons pass cta-real; another profile, a share link, the network's home and the business's live menu fail.

tests: the brief gives its WhatsApp and its social profiles, nothing that is not an address; no brief gives none
the site check's page read sends the brief's links with every call to the host
with them, the contact page's network buttons and the WhatsApp button pass cta-real; another profile does not
